card.name: Words just before metabolic activation or enzymes
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, an, a, without) right before a metabolism term such as metabolic activation, liver enzymes or CYP. Also 'hep' in 'hepatic' before drug-metabolizing enzymes, in mutagenicity tests and enzyme-induction statements.

modes.label: Presence or absence of activation
modes.description: Linking words after 'presence or absence' or 'with or without' before a metabolic activation system.
modes.example: when tested in the presence or absence<< of>> an in vitro metabolic activation system

modes.label: Enzyme inducer wording
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'hepatic' after 'inducer' or 'induction', before enzyme or metabolism names.
modes.example: Tobacco smoke is a moderate inducer<< of>> CYP1A2.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like metabolism, toxicity and toxic as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a metabolism or liver-enzyme term, as in activation assays and enzyme-inducer statements.
